start: The admin app or the member app calls the gym server through app.mettleup.fit/sb

steps.action: The app sends a call to /sb/rest/v1/...
user_sees: The gym server's answer, with the X-Forge-Proxy stamp
must_not: Cookies passed on to the gym server
An answer that runs as a page on the admin app address

start: The owner sends a message to members from Messages & offers

steps.action: The proxy tells the HQ Worker to send at once
user_sees: Members' phones get the pop-up within seconds
must_not: The pop-up waiting for the next minute
A pop-up when the send failed

start: The owner answers a member's workout question

user_sees: The member's phone gets the answer at once

start: The gym server does not answer

user_sees: Status 502 and 'The gym server could not be reached. Try again.' with the unreachable stamp
must_not: A Cloudflare page read as a real answer

user_sees: Not passed on to the gym server

start: Cloudflare's free daily limit is used up

steps.action: An app call to /sb gets Cloudflare's error page with no stamp
user_sees: The apps use the gym server's own address for a while
The answer with nosniff and a sandbox rule
must_not: Our site's cookies reaching the gym server
A gym server answer able to read the desks' saved keys
